result.brief: 提出基于Boids人工生命的群体规模多智能体视频世界模型测试平台FlockWorld，以及联合生成多智能体同步第一视角视频的动作条件潜扩散Transformer FlockDiT。
result.reason: Introduces a multi-agent action-conditioned video world model (FlockDiT) with synchronized egocentric generation and rollout fidelity analysis, directly matching video world models.
